items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 3:1
items.html: The mutual grasp of the vessels one within another: the illumination of the HG of Ima, which raises the bottom Hey to the Einayim and thereby makes the left line in every ten Sefirot, as is known, is found to hold all the vessels of these ten Sefirot within one another, and binds them together as though they were a single Sefira and a single vessel, since afterward the coupling is made upon this coarseness in the left, and the level is drawn in direct and reflected light, and thereby the discernment of the middle line is decided, and then the three lines are found bound and joined one to another. For the right line, which is the essence of the ten Sefirot, receives the illumination of the middle line through the coupling made upon the left line, as above. (Item 7).
